module_summary: Wishbone bus upsizer: registers each narrow request shifted into the wide word, pushes its sub-word offset into a FIFO, and uses the popped offset to shift returned wide data back.

anchors.name: i_sstb
anchors.why: Narrow-side request strobe; loads a new wide request into the outgoing registers.

anchors.name: i_sdata
anchors.why: Narrow write data, zero-extended and shifted into the wide word.

anchors.name: o_sdata
anchors.why: Narrow read data sliced from the shifted return word.

anchors.name: o_wstb
anchors.why: Wide-side request strobe, gated by FIFO full; also pushes shift into FIFO.

anchors.name: o_wdata
anchors.why: Wide write data driven from shifted request register.

anchors.name: o_waddr
anchors.why: Wide word address from registered upper narrow address bits.

anchors.name: o_sstall
anchors.why: Stall to narrow master when request pending and FIFO full or wide stalls.

anchors.name: o_sack
anchors.why: Registered acknowledge to narrow side, one cycle after wide ack.

anchors.name: i_wack
anchors.why: Wide-side ack; pops offset FIFO and captures return data.

anchors.name: UPSIZE.r_shift
anchors.why: Latched sub-word offset of request, pushed into offset FIFO.

anchors.name: UPSIZE.rtn_data
anchors.why: Wide return data shifted by FIFO offset to align narrow read data.

anchors.name: UPSIZE.fifo_full
anchors.why: Offset FIFO full; blocks wide strobe and stalls narrow side.

anchors.name: UPSIZE.fifo_shift
anchors.why: Popped offset selecting shift amount for returned data.

anchors.name: UPSIZE.w_shift
anchors.why: Low narrow address bits selecting data/sel shift position.

anchors.name: i_saddr
anchors.why: Narrow address split into wide address and sub-word offset.

anchors.name: i_wdata
anchors.why: Wide read data captured into return register on ack.

anchors.name: o_wcyc
anchors.why: Wide bus cycle from r_cyc; qualifies ack and error capture.

anchors.name: i_werr
anchors.why: Wide bus error; aborts cycle and request registers, forwarded as error.

anchors.name: o_serr
anchors.why: Registered error to narrow side; also clears cycle state.

anchors.name: i_swe
anchors.why: Write-enable command latched into wide request.

groups.name: request_register
groups.description: Registers narrow request, shifting data and select into wide word and address.

groups.name: offset_fifo
groups.description: FIFO of outstanding sub-word offsets, pushed on wide strobe and popped on ack.

groups.name: return_path
groups.description: Shifts wide return data by offset and registers ack/error to narrow side.

groups.name: flow_control
groups.description: Narrow-side request acceptance and stall generation.
